name: python-minhash-lsh
title: MinHash and LSH
blurb: Near-duplicate detection whose error is predicted before it is measured: a MinHash signature agrees on each position with probability equal to the Jaccard similarity of the shingle sets, so the estimate carries a binomial error of 1/sqrt(width); banding turns that signature into a candidate set whose false-negative rate follows an S-curve you choose, and every candidate is verified before two documents are called the same. The demo prints the predicted banding curve beside the recall it actually got.
default_description: Near-duplicate detection with MinHash and LSH: signatures whose agreement estimates Jaccard, banding with an S-curve you choose, and recall measured against the exact answer.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
